dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Defectors!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: I don't suppose you're here to listen to us play?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: No! Not unless you intend to play out an apology and surrender!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I don't know how you've managed to make it so far with just your little band and microscopic stage-

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: I'll have you know that this stage is actually pretty big.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: You know how long it takes to move around?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Not that long because it's all automatic.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: But imagine how long it'd take if we had to move it manually!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Nuts and bolts, you're insufferable.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Give up Commandeer, you don't have the power to stop Project Overture!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Okay hold on, stop.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: What is that?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: The sounds of our unified goal!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: NO, there's a drum and a decal, what is that?

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Oh, I thought we already explain, Project Overture is-

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I ALREADY KNOW WHAT THIS PROJECT IS! STOP SAYING IT!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: What, are you talking about Project Overture?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: What's wrong with saying Project Overture?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: I think Project Overture is a perfectly good name.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: STOP SAYING Project Overture!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: RAAAAH!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: You should consider yourselves LUCKY that I hadn't come until now to PERSONALLY destroy your little faction, defectors!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I had thought that other bots would have been competent enough to halt this disruption.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: But it is clear that I'll need to put a personal hand into the matter.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: It's time to end this, defectors! Be prepared to play nothing but silence!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Good going Flat, now it's mad.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: What?! It was mad before I did anything.
